observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox One console with a disc drive slot and a warning label on the front. The console has a textured surface and a small circular logo on the right side.
Photo 1 shows the same console with a black Xbox One controller placed on top. The controller has the standard Xbox layout: D-pad, analog sticks, and colored face buttons (X, Y, A, B).
The console appears to be in used condition with some visible wear and smudges on the surface.
The seller claims it comes with one pad, six games including FC, and an adaptor issue.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in the photos.
The console is not shown powered on or connected to a screen.

identity.kind: Xbox One console with one controller

claims.claim: Xbox one with one pad for sell
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows the console and one controller.
No games or game cases are visible in the photos. The claim cannot be verified remotely.
No power adapter is visible in the photos. The claim about an adaptor issue cannot be confirmed or denied from the images.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: Video or photo of the controller connecting to the console and being used to play a game.

risks.risk: Games may be missing, damaged, or not included

risks.risk: Adaptor may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the power adapter and a video of it being plugged in and the console powering on.

Video or photo of the controller connecting to the console and being used to play a game.
Photos of all six games with their cases or discs.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
